subject: Insurance
title: Mobile Money Insurance in Africa
description: A 60-second lesson on Mobile Money Insurance in Africa.

hook.text: In Kenya, M-Pesa users can buy life insurance by sending an SMS.

buildup.text: M-Pesa transformed Kenya's financial system. Adding insurance to mobile money was the logical next step.

discovery.text: Premiums are deducted from mobile money balances. Claims are paid directly to phones.

twist.text: Claim ratios are low. Many policyholders don't know how to file a claim or don't trust they'll actually receive payment.

climax.text: Mobile insurance removes distribution barriers. But claims literacy and trust remain major hurdles in emerging markets.

quiz.question: What challenge remains for mobile insurance in Africa?
options: Many policyholders don't know how to file claims or trust the system
